name: BoostHook
rootCause: On May 12, 2026, BoostHook's Uniswap V4 leveraged-long hook on Ethereum Mainnet was exploited for approximately $187,000. The attacker manipulated spot price to mint overleveraged positions, exploited a liquidation cap, and exited with 20.93 WETH profit, leaving the protocol with significant bad debt. The BoostHook contract relied on manipulable spot pool prices to open leveraged positions and capped same-block liquidations at five, allowing attackers to create toxic debt positions faster than the protocol could liquidate them.
